title: 日本ダービーの後に・挽回に向けて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She didn't win, but even so, Vodka showed her determination and ran a great race!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… Just… a little more!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I was so close! Augh! Damn it! Grrrrr!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Everyone was wicked fast… The Derby's no joke…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This is what I've been workin' for this whole time… Augh!
choice_data_list: You did a great job, Vodka.
You did a great job, Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I know. But I'm still frustrated… Sob…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No… I… I don't even know why I'm crying.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All I know is I'm glad I ran… Augh! Why does the sky have to be so blue?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka only had one shot at the Derby, and she ran it through to the end without compromising her ideals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't know if it was the right choice, but at the very least, Vodka made good on her dream of running in the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the press conference…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The winner was really amazin'! There's no denyin' that. That said…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Who knows what's gonna happen next, though? You see, I've got the perfect plan to get even better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Somehow, I have a bad feeling about this.

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text: Could you share it with us, Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: In order to hone my skills… I'm gonna run internationally!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'll get super strong and make everyone eat my dust!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Whoooooa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Run… internationally? Standing behind the reporters, I put my head in my hands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later that evening…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm really sorry about earlier! I didn't mean anything by it. I just…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I got caught up in the moment! I got too excited.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Considering Vodka's skills, it'd probably be best to go back to the Tiara tour and get ready to run in the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If we tried to squeeze an international race in, I can't even begin to imagine the burden it'll put on her.
choice_data_list: Do you really want to go abroad?
Do you really want to go abroad?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I said it, so there's no takin' it back now. I don't wanna take it back either.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna be that Umamusume who just did "okay" in the Derby… And this is the only way forward I can think of.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer? …No?
choice_data_list: …Maybe we do the Shuka Sho after we get back?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No! Not the Shuka Sho. I said I wanna go abroad…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait. After we get back?
choice_data_list: Yeah. After you're done running internationally.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's right! This is how it's gotta be, partner!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You really get me! And you're right, it'll be autumn when we get back!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let's go abroad! And then I'll come back and conquer the Shuka Sho as a world-famous Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And so our agenda changes to include running internationally.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Lemme say it one more time. Thanks for letting me run the Derby, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But our journey ain't over yet! The two of us can go even further!
